questions.markdown: Explain the construction and working of glass electrode (ion selective electrode). Write two advantages and disadvantages.

The gaseous reaction $A+B \rightleftharpoons C+D$ is studied in a one-liter vessel at $250\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$. The initial concentration of A is three times the initial concentration of B. After equilibrium is attained, the concentration of C is found to be equal to the concentration of B. Calculate the equilibrium constant of the reaction.

Give Reason for the following:

i) Conductivity of metals decreases at high temperatures.

ii) Brittle nature of Ionic compounds.

Explain the following:

i) Metallic bonding in Li with suitable diagram and its conduction through band overlapping.

ii) Criteria for Resonance and orbital approach to benzene.

Derive the relationship between hydrolysis constant $(K_H)$, ionic product of water $(K_w)$ and dissociation constant of acid $(K_a)$ for hydrolysis of $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$. Calculate the hydrolysis constant for $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$, if $K_a$ for $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ at $25\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ is $1.74\times 10^{-5}$.
Explain liquid junction potential with potential expression. Give the functions of the salt bride.
